business_summary: Nantong Acetic Acid Chemical Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of fine chemicals in China and internationally. The company offers food and feed additives comprising acesulfame potassium, sorbic acid, potassium sorbate, dehydroacetic acid, sodium dehydroacetate, nicotinic acid, nicotinamide, and clopidol; pharmaceutical and pesticide intermediates consisting of methyl acetoacetate, ethyl acetoacetate, 2-cyanopyridine, 3-cyanopyridine, and 4-cyanopyridine; and organic chemical raw materials, such as diketene, acetonitrile, and crotonaldehyde. It also provides dye and pigment intermediates, including acetoacetanilide; 2-methylacetoacetanilide; N-acetoacetyl-4-methylaniline; o-acetoacetaniside; p-acetoacetaniside; p-acetophenetidide; 2,4-dimethylacetoacetanilide; acetoacetic-2,5-dimethoxyanilide; 4-chloro-2,5-dimethoxyacetoacetanilide; 2-chloroacetoacetanilide; N,N'-(1,4-phenylene)bis(acetoacetamide); 1-(p-tolyl)-3-methyl-5-pyrazolone; 1-phenyl-3-methyl-5-pyrazolone; 5-acetoacetlamino benzimdazolone; and naphthol AS-G. In addition, the company offers customized products, such as sodium acetate anhydrous; N-methylacetoacetamide; 2-isopropyl-4-methyl-6-pyrimidinone; 3-methyl-1-(4-sulfophenyl)-5-pyrazolone; 1-(3-sulfophenyl)-3-methyl-5-pyrazolone; 1-(3'-chlorophenyl)-3-methyl-5-pyrazolone; and 1-(2-chlorophenyl)-3-methyl-5-pyrazolone. Further, it provides R&D related products, such as 5-methyl-3,4-dihydro-2H-chromene-6-carboxylic acid; pyrithione zinc; copperpyrithione; sodium pyrithione; calcium sorbate; isopropyl acetoacetate; tert-butyl acetoacetate; 2-(acetoacetoxy)ethyl methacrylate; chloroacetyl chloride; 2,6-dichlorobenzonitrile; l(-)-carnitine; 2-chloropyridine; 3-chlorine pyridine; 2,3-dichloropyridine; and 2,4-dichloropyridine. The company exports its products. Nantong Acetic Acid Chemical Co., Ltd. was founded in 1959 and is based in Nantong, China.
